title: The sequence \texorpdfstring{$\sqrt{k}/k!$}{sqrt(k)/k!} is a multiplier sequence
established: $\{\sqrt{k}/k!\}_{k\ge0}$ is a multiplier sequence; its exponential generating function has simple negative nonzero zeros with explicit quadratic localization.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: The square-root factorial sequence is a multiplier sequence; nonzero generating-function zeros are simple and negative.
